I've invested in some serious eye-area repair! The drmtlgy HPR Eye Cream is known for its high-performance retinoid bIend. needed an eye cream that actually works on fine lines and creepiness, and this is it! The key ingredient is HPR (Hydroxypinacolone Retinol, which is a next-generation retinoid. It delivers all the powerful benefits of retinol—like smoothing out wrinkles and firming the skin but without all the irritation that used to make my under-eyes angry. The texture is great—it's silky, lightweight, and absorbs fast. It doesn't pill or feel greasy, which is huge when I want to apply concealer over it in the morning. I notice a huge difference in the texture; my under-eyes look smoother and more awake. It also helps with the look of crepey skin and dark circles over time because it promotes cell turnover. It's the ultimate high-tech eye product! It gives me the anti-aging benefits of a retinoid—tighter, smoother, brighter eyes—but it's gentle enough to use every single night!
This eye cream is really great. I loved the other one and this one even more!

avis.titre: I love this eye cream with all my heart
avis.texte: I've been using the DRMTLGY HPR Eye Cream for a few weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and feels very gentle around the eyes. I noticed that my under-eye area looks smoother and more hydrated, and fine lines appear softer. What I love most is that it includes a retinoid but doesn't irritate my skin at all. My eyes look more awake and refreshed, even on days when I don't get enough sleep. Overall, this has become a staple in my nighttime routine. Definitely worth the price! Highly recommend if you're looking for an effective yet gentle eye cream.
